## Standards
This project follows **devbook @ v<X.Y.Z>** (pinned at `docs/devbook/`).

**Mandatory baseline, always applies.** The profiles listed in `devbook.json` (always `core`, plus <web / mobile / llm-features>) are generated by `node docs/devbook/bin/devbook-sync.mjs` into:
- `.claude/rules/devbook-*.md`, which Claude Code loads at launch
- `.github/instructions/devbook-*.instructions.md`, which Copilot applies to every file

Any other agent **MUST** read `.claude/rules/devbook-*.md` before its first change. Never hand-edit these files. CI runs `devbook-sync.mjs --check` and fails on drift.

Precedence: project rules here and in `docs/` override the baseline only when written down explicitly. Loosening a security, privacy, accessibility, testing or content-honesty rule needs an ADR in `docs/adr/`. On any unclear conflict, stop and ask.

## Never
- Never invent facts, APIs, packages, file paths, test results, citations, people or credentials. Ask, or leave `TODO(<area>)` and report it.
- Never add a dependency without asking.
- Never weaken or delete a test to make it pass.
- Never commit secrets or put them in prompts, logs or client code.
- Never touch <auth / payments / migrations / infra / production data> without an approved plan.
- <project-specific never-rules>

## Workflow
1. Read the spec section for the task. If acceptance criteria are missing or unclear, ask.
2. Propose a plan (tasks, files, risks, questions) and wait for approval on non-trivial work.
3. One small task at a time; run checks; report with the task-report format from the devbook workflow page.
4. Update docs, ADRs and the changelog in the same change.
